scope: M0 typed contract and design review only; runtime qualification remains open

rustdoc.command: RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --locked -p connect-protocol -p connect-store -p connect-service --no-deps

design_review: All seven task states and six effect states exhaustively checked
Unknown ownership/binding/admin fields and wildcards rejected
Nested delegated mutations preserve one logical ID; nondelegatable admin denied
Grants and tool waits are explicitly bounded; provider correlation is never authority
Current-authorized replay and two-task isolation require store/service checks
Grant refresh remains protected composition; model cannot self-renew
Legacy source timestamps remain explicit instead of fabricated
Native Reply uses current sender send authority and a verified question reference; model cannot choose task owner. Runtime reply admission remains G4-009.
Explicit Send wait_for_reply defaults false; only its own attributed answer completes the wait.
Claim, ClaimGet and ReleaseClaim use owner scopes, bounded CAS leases and immutable replay expiry; narrow model grants cannot claim.
Known effect errors are additive optional fields; legacy effects without protected metadata cannot fabricate success.
